description: Pointer opens 'Try an example' and switches from Identity to L3A. The page fades over to 86.11, 'Rushed in the middle, then fading', then scrolls to the three biggest fixes: Rushed -4.89, Volume drops -3.81, Missing pause -3.56.
Still, last frame of the open_example shot.
Fresh page load on the default example: the reference and 'this recording' waveforms draw in, the delivery score ring ticks up, and the rose flag bands light one by one in the time view.
Still, last frame of the hero shot.
L3A from 12.02 s: pointer clicks Play recording; the word highlight moves from 'like to stand' past 'morning', 'the Washington Monument and then' and the faded 'humidity is low you can see past the'.
Still, last frame of the transcript_karaoke shot.

L3A: the Volume drops finding is open; the pointer clicks the flagged words 'the Washington Monument and then'. The panel switches to #3 Rushed -4.89 pts (0.87 s in your reading, 1.62 s in the reference, how to fix). Then it clicks Listen and playback runs.
Still, last frame of the finding shot.

Pointer opens the example menu and picks Identity (placebo chain): score 100.00, 'The reference itself: nothing to fix', no flag bands, plain transcript, 'Nothing crosses its threshold: this reading matches the reference.', Every finding (0).
Still, last frame of the clean shot.

Upload form: L3A.wav chosen as your recording, Reference set to 'Upload my own reference recording', reagan_farewell_1989.wav chosen, transcript already filled in. Ends on the Analyse button; nothing is submitted.
Still, last frame of the upload shot.
